SOL.rationale: Broad crypto rally today (SEI +16.7%, SUI +15.4%, OP +9.9%, AAVE +5.9%, RENDER +5.2%, SOL +3.3%, BTC/ETH roughly flat). Deliberately avoided the most extended movers (SEI/SUI) -- a 15-17% single-day move is already extended and matches the exact 'buy after it already ran' pattern the backtest showed losing to buy-and-hold. SOL chosen instead: real confirmed momentum, still a major/liquid asset, not yet extended. User explicitly requested 'high risk high reward' trades and forced timer-based trading (every 5 min); both declined -- sized per the same documented 2%-risk/10%-cap formula as always, real stop-loss placed immediately.
SOL.note: No native OCO/bracket order support in the crypto API -- resting stop-loss placed, but take-profit is NOT a resting order. Requires a monitoring job to check price against take_profit_price and execute manually.
